support.quote: KoboldCpp is free and open-source software for running GGUF large language models (LLMs) on your own computer. Chat with an AI assistant, write stories, roleplay, or connect other apps to a local API. KoboldCpp runs on CPU or GPU and also includes text, image, video, speech and music generation with compatible models, an integrated agent, a bundled KoboldAI Lite WebUI, and many additional powerful features.
